why_this_port: The installed client is the Compatibility Mode executable. The original 951-3 executable (fd8afd32...358d45) is no longer installed, so a tile layout on it cannot be checked statically or live.
The Compatibility Mode profile already pinned the scene global, the local actor path, the tile getters and the +0xf18 hit ring forwarder. Only the player actor vtable was missing.
Porting the tile to the original executable would need its own scene path or a second tile layout in the generator, plus verification on a binary that is no longer available.
Compatibility Mode also exposes the NPC action application stamp, which detects repeated animations that the original profile cannot.

constructor.finding: lea rax,[rip+0x1100cc1] resolves to 0x150d8c8 and is stored to [rdi] after a call to the shared actor base constructor 0xc3bf00. The NPC constructor calls the same base constructor before storing NPC vtable 0x15b3a88.

runtime_id_getter.finding: movzx eax, word [rcx+0x88]; stores it with UID type 2 (player). The NPC vtable's same slot is 0xc50960, identical except UID type 1 (NPC).

fine_coordinate_getter.finding: Slot 0xb0 of 0x150d8c8 is the already pinned lea rax,[rcx+0x280]; ret, which the pinned tile instruction at 0x44cd4f calls through [rax+0xb0].

hit_ring.finding: Base-class forwarder 0xc42d70 reads [rcx+0xf18] (already pinned at 0xc42d9e). Player and NPC actors share the base constructor 0xc3bf00, and vtable slots 3 and 4 (hit and headbar entry points 0xc42a80 and 0xc429d0) are identical in both vtables.

static_evidence.original_profile_analogue: Original: client vtable 0x15367c0, player actor vtable 0x15367e0 (+0x20). Compatibility Mode: 0x150d8a8 and 0x150d8c8 (+0x20), the same 0x28f18 shift.
static_evidence.rtti: The executable carries no RTTI type names; class identity rests on the constructor, the UID type and the shared slots above.
